ei.lesson: The belief that vision is important...

fullPassage:
The belief that vision is important to driving safely is the reason why measurements of visual capability are an integral part of the test for issuing a driving licence in most countries.

(A) The fact is the drivers' task is a complex one, involving both visual and cognitive factors. Within a very limited time, the driver has to interpret what is likely to happen on the road ahead.

(B) Despite these requirements, attempts to find a link between simple visual functions such as visual sharpness and the accident record of drivers have proved largely fruitless. This may be because drivers with worse visual capabilities are aware of their abilities and drive within limits. Alternatively, it may be that the visual capabilities measured are too simple.

(C) To do this, the driver has developed a series of expectations of other drivers' behaviour and of what are the appropriate locations to examine. The driver will be faced with objects of different degrees of visibility and noticeability and will have to make judgements for which the visual system is not always well suited.

Within a very limited time, the driver has to interpret what is likely to happen on the road ahead. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ② (A) integral(필수적인) (B) cognitive(인지적인) (C) fruitless(성과 없는) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
❌ ① marginal(주변적인) - cognitive(인지적인) - fruitless(성과 없는): (A) marginal은 시력 측정이 운전면허 시험의 주변적인 부분이라는 의미로 문맥상 부적절
✅ ② integral(필수적인) - cognitive(인지적인) - fruitless(성과 없는): 세 단어 모두 원문 그대로 ← 정답
❌ ③ integral(필수적인) - physical(신체적인) - fruitless(성과 없는): (B) physical은 인지적 요소가 아닌 신체적 요소로 문맥 불일치
❌ ④ marginal(주변적인) - physical(신체적인) - productive(생산적인): 세 단어 모두 오류

questions.passage: The belief that vision is important to driving safely is the reason why measurements of visual capability are an ①<u>integral</u> part of the test for issuing a driving licence in most countries. The fact is the drivers' task is a ②<u>complex</u> one, involving both visual and cognitive factors.
